phase: Phase 8: Multi-Channel Intercom, Priority Emergency & Audio Spatialization

stories.title: Multi-Channel Group Partitioning & Channel Manager
stories.description: Implement ChannelManager in commonMain supporting sub-channel creation, channel switching, and channel-tagged packet segregation across the mesh.
acceptanceCriteria: ChannelManager provides active channel switching across 16 configurable sub-channels
Filters audio packets based on matching active channel or global broadcast flags
Emits reactive channel state flow for UI selection

stories.title: Emergency Priority Voice & Hazard Alert Broadcast
stories.description: Implement PriorityBroadcastManager allowing emergency override frames (hazard warnings, crash alerts) to preempt ongoing audio and bypass sub-channel mutes.
acceptanceCriteria: Classifies frames with PriorityLevel (NORMAL, PRIORITY, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE)
EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE preempts lower priority audio playout immediately
Generates audible pre-roll alert chime tone synthesis in pure KMP

stories.title: Binaural Stereo Audio Spatializer & Convoy Panning
stories.description: Implement SpatialAudioProcessor in commonMain to render incoming mono voice streams into 3D stereo audio panned by rider radar azimuth and distance.
acceptanceCriteria: Pans mono 16-bit PCM into interleaved stereo (-90 left to +90 right degrees)
Applies distance attenuation curve and interaural time delay (ITD) emulation

stories.title: Adaptive RF Interference & Frequency Map Diagnostic Engine
stories.description: Implement RfInterferenceDetector in commonMain to monitor 2.4 GHz channel congestion, calculate noise variance, and advise BLE transport backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Tracks packet delivery ratio dips and RSSI standard deviation over sliding window
Classifies RF interference levels (LOW, MODERATE, SEVERE)
Recommends transmission backoff and packet redundancy boost under high noise
